CREATE TABLE p (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    uid VARCHAR(36),
    t INTEGER
  )

CREATE TABLE pa (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    a_uid VARCHAR(36)
  )

CREATE TABLE a (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    uid VARCHAR(36),
    t INTEGER
  )

SELECT DISTINCT pa.id, p.id, a.id
  FROM
    pa
    LEFT JOIN p ON p.uid='1234'
    LEFT JOIN a ON a.uid=pa.a_uid
  WHERE
    a.t=p.t

SELECT DISTINCT pa.id, p.id, a.id
  FROM
    pa
    LEFT JOIN p ON p.uid='1234'
    LEFT JOIN a ON a.uid=pa.a_uid AND a.t=p.t
  ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
